# 0 Set up environment
```{r}
# Clean environment
rm( list = ls() )

# load libraries
library(qqman)
library(circlize)
library(VennDiagram)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggplot2)
library(phytools)
library(ape)
library(treeio)
library(ggtree)
library(ggnewscale)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(cartography)
library(khroma)
library(xlsx)

# Load CDC and NL accessions
library(xlsx)
NL_metadata <- read.xlsx2("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/0.Raw_data/Netherlands_Sanger_metadata.xlsx", 1) 
NL_accessions <- NL_metadata |> pull(ENA.lane.accession)
CDC_metadata <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/0.Raw_data/phenotypes_CDC.txt", header=T) 
CDC_accessions <- CDC_metadata |> pull(samples)

# Import tree
Fasttree <- read.tree("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Phylogenies/CDC_NLD/FastTree_phylo.tre")
Fasttree_mid <- midpoint.root(Fasttree)

# Load metadata
serotypes <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Strain Typing/CDC_NDL/Serotypes.txt", header=T) |> mutate(GBS.SBG = ifelse(GBS.SBG=="", NA, GBS.SBG)) 
CCs <- read.csv("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Strain Typing/CDC_NDL/combined_results_with_cc.txt") |> dplyr::select(Sample, clonal_complex)
SCs <- read.csv("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Strain Typing/CDC_NDL/GBS_GWAS_db_core_clusters.csv") |> rename(Sample=Taxon, SC=Cluster)
STs <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Strain Typing/CDC_NDL/ST_results.txt") |>
  mutate(ST2 = str_remove(str_remove(ST,"\\*"),"\\?"))

# Load phenotypes
phenotypes <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/0.Raw_data/phenotypes_CDC_NDL.txt", header=T) |>
  rename(Sample =samples ) |> 
  mutate(Age_cat = ifelse(Sample %in% NL_accessions, ifelse(binary==1, "EOD", "LOD/VLOD"), ifelse(binary==1, "LOD/VLOD", "EOD")))


# Prep metadata for tree
typing_data <- left_join(left_join(left_join(left_join(serotypes, CCs ), SCs), phenotypes), (STs |> dplyr::select(Sample, ST, ST2)))
fewer5_SC <- which(table(typing_data$SC)<=10)
metadata_tree <- typing_data |>
  mutate(SC2= ifelse(SC %in% fewer5_SC, "other", SC))|>
  mutate(SC2= factor(SC2, level=c(1:14, "other")))|>
  mutate(Serotype2 = str_remove(str_remove(GBS.SBG,"\\*"),"\\?"))|>
  mutate(Serotype2 = ifelse(grepl("III-", Serotype2), "III", Serotype2))|>
  mutate(Serotype2 = factor(Serotype2, levels=c("Ia", "Ib","II", "III", "IV", "V","VI","VII","VIII", "IX")))|> 
  rename("label" = "Sample")|> 
  filter(label %in% Fasttree_mid$tip.label)|>
  mutate(country = ifelse(label %in% NL_accessions, "NLD", 
                          ifelse(label %in% CDC_accessions, "USA", "other")))

# Fix missing CCs
ref_ST_cc_df <- rbind(unique(metadata_tree|> filter(!grepl("\\*", ST), !grepl("\\?", ST)) |> dplyr::select(ST, clonal_complex)), 
                       data.frame(ST= c(1750, 2107, 137, 1809, 235, 482, 1946, 2106, 234),
                                  clonal_complex=c("cc17", "cc17", "cc17", "cc23", "cc1", "cc17", "cc17", "cc19", "cc23")))

# Load CDC and NL accessions
NL_metadata <- read.xlsx("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/0.Raw_data/Netherlands_Sanger_metadata.xlsx", 1)
NL_accessions <- NL_metadata |> pull(ENA.lane.accession) 

# Join tree with metadata
metadata_tree_v0 <- unique(left_join(metadata_tree |> dplyr::select(-clonal_complex), ref_ST_cc_df |> rename(ST2=ST)) |> 
  mutate(clonal_complex = case_when(
    label == "SRR29440471" ~ "cc19",
    label == "SRR29458952" ~ "cc17",
    label == "SRR29459527" ~ "cc1",
    label == "SRR29476238" ~ "cc459",
    label == "SRR29480489" ~ "cc17",
    label == "SRR29489178" ~ "cc17",
    label == "SRR29489593" ~ "cc1",
    label == "SRR29489703" ~ "cc19",
    label == "SRR29506764" ~ "cc19",
    label == "SRR29506975" ~ "cc19",
    label == "SRR29508494" ~ "cc1",
    label == "SRR31502751" ~ "cc452",
    label == "SRR5063593" ~ "cc19",
    label == "ERR1659749" ~ "cc19",
    label == "SRR23753882" ~ "cc17",
    label == "SRR23754097" ~ "cc17",
    TRUE ~ clonal_complex # keep existing value for all others
  )) |> 
  mutate(clonal_complex = ifelse(ST2 %in% c(4,16,103, 130, 255, 929, 932, 1553, 1559,1580, 1606), "No CC", clonal_complex)))

# Prepare colors for phylo
Serotype_colors <- c(color("muted")(9),"#D55E00" , "grey")
names(Serotype_colors) <- levels(metadata_tree_v0$Serotype2)
CC_colors <- c("#8dcabd", "#e3b1b8", "#caecbc", "#d1bbdf", "#9db8da", "#e0bf9d", "#8ad6e4", "#e6d2c7", "#b9d7eb", "#aac5a4" ,"#ddaa98", "#a2bebd")
names(CC_colors) <- c("cc1",   "cc12" , "cc17" , "cc19",  "cc22",  "cc23"  ,"cc26"  ,"cc283", "cc327", "cc452", "cc459" ,"No CC")
```


# CDC dsitributions 
# Clonal Complex vs AGe Cat
```{r}
# chi-square tests of Clonal Complex vs Age_cat, stratified by country
metadata_tree_CDC <- metadata_tree_v0 |> filter(country == "USA")
chisq.test_CC_CDC <- chisq.test(metadata_tree_CDC$Age_cat, metadata_tree_CDC$clonal_complex)

p_labels_CC_CDC <- data.frame(pval= signif(chisq.test_CC_CDC$p.value , 3), 
                       X2= round(chisq.test_CC_CDC$statistic, 1))


# Summarise counts and percentages per country x Age_cat x Serotype2
df_pct_CC_CDC <- metadata_tree_CDC |>
  group_by(Age_cat, clonal_complex) |>
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(Age_cat) |>
  mutate(
    perc = count / sum(count) * 100,
    perc_label = ifelse(perc >= 1, paste0(round(perc), "%"), "")
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# Totals per bar (same as before but from df_pct)
bar_totals_CC_CDC <- df_pct_CC_CDC |>
  group_by(Age_cat) |>
  summarise(N = sum(count), .groups = "drop")


p_CC_CDC <- df_pct_CC_CDC |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Age_cat, y = perc, fill = clonal_complex)) +
  # stacked percentage bars (perc already in data)
  geom_col() +
  
  # percentage labels inside segments, only if >= 10%
  geom_text(
    aes(label = perc_label),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "white",
    size = 5
  ) +
  
  # total N at top of each bar
  geom_text(
    data = bar_totals_CC_CDC,
    aes(x = Age_cat, y = 102, label = paste0("n=", N)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, size=5
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Percentage",
    limits = c(0, 115),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")
  ) +
  xlab("Age Category") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Clonal Complex", values = CC_colors)+
  # add per-country p-values
  geom_text(
    aes(x = 1.3, y = 115, label = paste0("χ²= ", p_labels_CC_CDC$X2)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,          # left-justify
    size = 4
  ) +
  # add per-country p-values
  geom_text(
    aes(x = 1.25, y = 110, label = paste0("p = ", p_labels_CC_CDC$pval)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,          # left-justify
    size = 4
  ) +
  # segment above bars connecting them
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 1, xend = 2, y = 107, yend = 107),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.7
  )+
  # segment above bars connecting them
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 1, xend = 1, y = 105, yend = 107),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.7
  )+
  # segment above bars connecting them
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 2, xend = 2, y = 105, yend = 107),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.7
  )+
  ggtitle("Serotype Distribution\nEOD vs LOD/VLOD")+ theme(
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size =15),
    axis.title   = element_text(size = 15),   # axis titles
    axis.text    = element_text(size = 13),   # axis tick labels
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15),   # legend title
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 13)    # legend labels
  )

# Serotype vs AGe Cat
# chi-square tests 
chisq.test_Serotype_CDC <- chisq.test(metadata_tree_CDC$Age_cat, metadata_tree_CDC$Serotype2)
p_labels_Serotype_CDC <- data.frame(pval= signif(chisq.test_Serotype_CDC$p.value , 3),

# Combine 
p_CDC <- p_CC_CDC + p_Serotype_CDC
ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/2. Analysis/MS1 - USA GWAS interpretation/CDC_CC_Sero_Barplots.png", p_CDC, width = 12, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

# Clonal Complex vs AGe Cat in each country
```{r}
# chi-square tests of Clonal Complex vs Age_cat, stratified by country
metadata_tree_CDC <- metadata_tree_v0 |> filter(country == "USA")
metadata_tree_NLD <- metadata_tree_v0 |> filter(country == "NLD")

chisq.test_CC_CDC <- chisq.test(metadata_tree_CDC$Age_cat, metadata_tree_CDC$clonal_complex)
chisq.test_CC_NLD <- chisq.test(metadata_tree_NLD$Age_cat, metadata_tree_NLD$clonal_complex)

p_labels_CC <- data.frame(country= c("USA", "NLD"), 
                       pval= c(signif(chisq.test_CC_CDC$p.value , 3), signif(chisq.test_CC_NLD$p.value , 3)), 
                       X2= c(round(chisq.test_CC_CDC$statistic, 1), round(chisq.test_CC_NLD$statistic, 1)))


# Summarise counts and percentages per country x Age_cat x Serotype2
df_pct_CC <- metadata_tree_v0 |>
  filter(country != "other") |>
  group_by(country, Age_cat, clonal_complex) |>
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(country, Age_cat) |>
  mutate(
    perc = count / sum(count) * 100,
    perc_label = ifelse(perc >= 1, paste0(round(perc), "%"), "")
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# Totals per bar (same as before but from df_pct)
bar_totals_CC <- df_pct_CC |>
  group_by(country, Age_cat) |>
  summarise(N = sum(count), .groups = "drop")


p_CC <- df_pct_CC |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Age_cat, y = perc, fill = clonal_complex)) +
  # stacked percentage bars (perc already in data)
  geom_col() +
  
  # percentage labels inside segments, only if >= 10%
  geom_text(
    aes(label = perc_label),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "white",
    size = 5
  ) +
  
  # total N at top of each bar
  geom_text(
    data = bar_totals_CC,
    aes(x = Age_cat, y = 102, label = paste0("n=", N)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, size=5
  ) +
  
  facet_grid(. ~ country) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Percentage",
    limits = c(0, 115),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")
  ) +
  xlab("Age Category") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Clonal Complex", values = CC_colors)+
  # add per-country p-values
  geom_text(
    data = p_labels_CC,
    aes(x = 1.3, y = 115, label = paste0("χ²= ", X2)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,          # left-justify
    size = 4
  ) +
  # add per-country p-values
  geom_text(
    data = p_labels_CC,
    aes(x = 1.25, y = 110, label = paste0("p = ", pval)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,          # left-justify
    size = 4
  ) +
  # segment above bars connecting them
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 1, xend = 2, y = 107, yend = 107),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.7
  )+
  # segment above bars connecting them
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 1, xend = 1, y = 105, yend = 107),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.7
  )+
  # segment above bars connecting them
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 2, xend = 2, y = 105, yend = 107),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.7
  )+
  ggtitle("Clonal Complex Distribution\nEOD vs LOD/VLOD\n in the USA and Netherlands")+ theme(
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size =15),
    axis.title   = element_text(size = 15),   # axis titles
    axis.text    = element_text(size = 13),   # axis tick labels
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15),   # legend title
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 13)    # legend labels
  )

# Combine

ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/2. Analysis/MS1 - USA GWAS interpretation/CDC_vs_NDL_EOD_vs_LOD_CC_Sero_Barplots.png", p_CC_serotype, width = 15, height = 5, dpi = 300)
ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/2. Analysis/MS1 - USA GWAS interpretation/CDC_vs_NDL_EOD_vs_LOD_CC_Barplots.tiff", p_CC_serotype, width = 15, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
